const std = @import("std");
const xberg = @import("xberg");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/html\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/html/simple_table.html\"}", "{}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
